title: Head and neck single- and dual-energy CT: differences in radiation dose and image quality of 2nd and 3rd generation dual-source CT
lineage: University Hospital Frankfurt study of the different scanner generations and detector arrays.

passages.locator: Methods, Dual-source CT acquisition and image reconstruction
passages.note: Identifies Definition Flash as second-generation and Force as third-generation, corroborating the shared dual-source architecture and different detector configurations.
